an5.235:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu gihīnaṃ anukampati.
an5.235:1.7: mahā kho pana bhikkhusaṅgho abhikkanto nānāverajjakā bhikkhū, gihīnaṃ upasaṅkamitvā āroceti :
an5.235:1.8: “mahā kho āvuso, bhikkhusaṅgho abhikkanto, nānāverajjakā bhikkhū, karotha puññāni, samayo puññāni kātunti.”
an5.235:1.9: yaṃ kho panassa bhojanaṃ denti lūkhaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā taṃ attanā paribhuñjati, saddhādeyyaṃ na vinipāteti.
an5.235:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu gihīnaṃ anukampatīti.
